Package index

The workflow

From the real data to released output, in order.

mimic-package
mimic: synthetic data and output control for small populations
mimic_config()
Disclosure control settings for small populations
profile_data()
Describe a dataset safely
mimic()
Build a synthetic copy from a profile
mess_options()
Choose which kinds of mess to add
trial_run()
Try a script on the synthetic copy
real_run()
Run a script on the real data
inspect()
Check output before release
write_report()
Write an inspection report for the approver
record_release()
Record released output in a register

Safe output

For the researcher’s script, so output passes the inspection.

safe_output
Safe output for the researcher's script
safe_count()
Count persons with small cells suppressed
safe_summary()
Summarise a numeric variable without small or dominated groups
safe_model()
A table of model coefficients that is safe to release
describe_output()
Describe an output file for the checker

Checks

The rules behind the inspection, usable on their own.

checks
Disclosure and data checks
check_min_count()
Check that every cell has enough persons
check_k_anonymity()
Check combinations of quasi-identifiers (k-anonymity)
check_dominance()
Check that no few contributors dominate a sum
check_extremes()
Check for minimum, maximum and other single-person values
check_model()
Check that a model rests on enough observations
check_differencing()
Check that two tables cannot be subtracted
check_suppression()
Check that suppressed cells cannot be recovered
check_group_disclosure()
Check that no group shares one value of a variable
check_keys()
Check keys of linked tables
check_all()
Collect checks into one report
